name: Blagaj – Dervish Tekke & Buna River Spring
tagline: A half-day visit to the place where the Buna River rises from beneath a high rock face.
level: Easy: steps and uneven surfaces in places
description: Visit Blagaj, where the Buna River emerges from a powerful karst spring beneath a high rock face. The visit can include the historic Dervish Tekke, the riverside setting and an explanation of the area’s religious, cultural and natural significance.

itinerary.text: Travel from Mostar to Blagaj, if transport is arranged.
Visit the Buna River spring viewpoint.
Visit the Dervish Tekke, if you wish and opening conditions allow.
Time for photographs or a riverside break.

notIncluded: Transport, unless stated in the confirmed price
practical: Modest clothing for the Tekke: shoulders and knees covered.
notes: Brief lists €40 per person and also asks whether "the €30 rate" includes transport: confirm price, transport and Tekke entrance.
Confirm the actual time including driving. Distance "about 12 km" is our addition: confirm.
seoTitle: Blagaj Tour from Mostar: Dervish Tekke & Buna Spring
seoDescription: Half-day visit to Blagaj with a local guide from Mostar: the Buna River spring, the Dervish Tekke and the riverside setting.
